articles.title: Norway's King Harald V dies at 89 and his son becomes King Haakon VIII
articles.summary: King Harald V of Norway, who went into exile in the United States as a child during the Nazi occupation of his homeland and refused a string of European noblewomen to marry his school sweetheart, died Friday.
